title: Adding a constant to a density expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$, let $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $c\in\mathbb R$. The expectation of $F+c$ under $\varphi$ equals the expectation of $F$ under $\varphi$ plus $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$
$F$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
